a1.rationale: Add full jitter so many clients do not retry in step.

a2.rationale: Cap the retry delay at maxMs (default 30 s).

a2r.rationale: Rebase the delay cap on the jittered retry now on main.

a3.rationale: Signed retries: re-sign each attempt with Birch's signer.

a3r.rationale: Move onto Cove's released signer c5 after Birch withdrew b1.

b1.rationale: HMAC-SHA256 request signer. One helper came from an outside snippet with an unverified license; recorded here.

b2r.rationale: Rebase the vectors on b1 v2.

files.text:
# Signing requests

The SDK signs requests with HMAC-SHA256 (see the signer contribution b1).
Set `secret` in the client options to enable it.

b3.rationale: Documentation for signing. Cites b1; does not build on it.

b4.rationale: Clean replacement for b1, written from the specification. New signature hmacSigner(secret, keyId).

c1.rationale: Add a burst option to the rate limiter.

c2.rationale: Sign each request when a secret is set.

c2r.rationale: Rebase on b1 v2: pass the key id to the new signer.

# shared-sdk

A small HTTP client SDK built by three organizations.

- retry with jitter and a cap
- rate limiting with bursts
- request timeouts

c4.rationale: Unrelated README update during the incident.

c5.rationale: Cove's own HMAC signer for its gateway; same Signer interface.
